name: Bellagio Nocturne
promptTemplate: A nocturnal musical fountain display running {{choreography}} choreography in {{palette}} tones, reaching {{jet_height}} height with {{fog_mist}} mist and {{water_shimmer}} surface reflection.

palette.hint: Shift uplighting and sky searchlight hues

jet_height.hint: Scale overall fountain pressure and apex height

listing.blurb: A synchronized musical fountain display sways, fans, and shoots across a dark lake with glowing illuminated mist and water reflections.
listing.prompt: A musical fountain show at night: rows of water jets on a lake shoot, sway and fan out in choreography with the music, lit from beneath in shifting colours, spray drifting across the lights, the whole show reflected in the dark water. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
